statement.notes: 1. 'Sales revenue' mapped to 'revenue'. 2. 'total_operating_cost' calculated as sum of 'Cost of sales', 'Distribution expenses', 'Administrative expenses', 'Other operating expenses', minus 'Other operating income' (i.e., -265184 -22320 -12754 -20312 +14974 = -320570 for 2024). This represents total operating costs and expenses net of other operating income. 3. 'net_income' mapped to 'Volkswagen AG shareholders' portion of 'Earnings after tax' as this represents the consolidated net income attributable to the parent company's equity holders. 4. 'taxes' mapped to 'Income tax income/expense'. 5. 'interest_expenses' taken directly from the line item. All values are in € million as per the statement.
